title: Trump and Xi Agree: Iran Cannot Have Nuclear Weapons
detail: President Trump confirmed that he and Chinese President Xi Jinping are in full agreement that Iran must not be permitted to acquire nuclear weapons. The joint position was announced following bilateral summit talks in Beijing, representing a rare convergence of US and Chinese policy on the Iranian nuclear question at a pivotal moment in nuclear negotiations.

media.caption: Trump and Xi reach agreement that Iran cannot have nuclear weapons following Beijing summit
